cluster: C5: Client surfaces: categories, honest numbers, share (digests A5, R6, R12)

verdicts.recommendation: C5.1 Fragrance chip plus coming-soon chips, copy, event, backend allowlist
verdicts.reason: The client edits and the fire-and-forget event cost nothing. The claim of refusals at zero cost does not hold. _resolve_pair_category runs after parse_product_query on the q= path and after classify_category_llm when the names give no category. The camera path pays for vision first. Only Serper and the verdict are saved. A coming-soon tap invites typed skincare queries, and each one still pays for the parse.
evidence: C:/Users/SynAckITPC/Documents/AI/sc-s80-b2/app/services/structured_comparison_service.py:3957,4303,4347 - parse LLM, then category resolve, then fetch
verdicts.fix: Keep the client changes. Add a deterministic keyword pre-check before any LLM call (name classifier or KB lookup) for the zero-cost refusal, keep the post-parse check as a backstop, never charge a refusal against the 3/day quota, and measure what share of refusals still pays for a parse or vision call.

verdicts.recommendation: C5.2 Remove CohortBadge and fake numbers; add thresholded real counts
verdicts.reason: The removals cost nothing and stand. The replacements are unbuilt and unpriced. compare_runs and KB pair ids do not exist yet. A per-compare count query on the hot path adds about 381 ms unless it is precomputed. Price age is popped internally and never sent on the wire. At 100-1000 compares/day under a 3/day device cap, n>=20 per pair and >=20 raters per pair will almost never be met. Removing the badge also saves no backend cost.
verdicts.fix: Ship the removals now. Serve counts only from an off-path aggregate (nightly or cached by KB pair, never a live count on the compare path). Add price age and store count as additive wire keys behind a flag. Accept that the thresholded lines will rarely render, and measure how often they do.

verdicts.recommendation: C5.3 Per-channel share builder, openURL fallback, fixed text-only path
verdicts.reason: The builder costs no tokens and the text-only fix is free. But each channel tap awaits the fingerprint plus POST /referrals/share before opening anything. That route makes about 5 sequential sync Supabase calls (users read, comparisons read, invites insert, credits insert, users read), roughly 1.5-2 s. Each tap also writes a new invite row and a deep-review credit row. SMS, Email and More are rejected by the backend's share-target set and the 014 CHECK unless mapped to other.
verdicts.fix: Create the invite once when the sheet opens, or cache share_link per comparison, so channel taps open instantly and do not write duplicate invite and credit rows. Map SMS, Email and More to 'other' until the migration widens the CHECK.

verdicts.recommendation: C5.4 Landing OG tags plus dark per-comparison OG route
verdicts.reason: Static OG tags and one image cost nothing and stand. The dynamic route does not. nginx is a static template (envsubst sets PORT only), so it cannot follow a per-call backend flag. Each crawler fetch through resolve_invite costs 3 reads (one of them full_response) plus a first_viewed_at write that bots trigger. Pillow is in dev requirements only. Render time, cache location and crawler timeouts are unmeasured.
verdicts.fix: Ship the static OG now. For per-comparison OG, write a small sanitized preview snapshot and pre-rendered image once at share time. Serve them from a read-only cached route that never writes first_viewed_at. Switch nginx with its own landing env plus a redeploy, not the backend flag.

verdicts.recommendation: C5.5 Native 1.0.1 share kits, image card, measurement
verdicts.reason: No server or token cost. But the plan to measure conversion through /c/ visits has no backend counter: /c/ is static nginx, so the only data is landing access logs inflated by preview crawlers. The device time for a view-shot capture of a 720x1280 Stories card is unmeasured.
verdicts.fix: Count conversion from in-app resolve_invite opens and referral redemptions with crawler user agents excluded, and measure view-shot capture time on a low-end Android before committing to image cards.

new_risks: Loop 2 still grants bonus comparisons for 7 days when an invited friend signs up. That conflicts with the single 3-per-day device rule, and a better share flow would raise LLM spend through it.

Anonymous and fresh compares have no comparison_id, so they never get a real link. Turning on ENABLE_COMPARISON_ID_ECHO adds a 285 ms insert RTT to every compare and requires ENABLE_SUPABASE_CLIENT_REUSE first (CLAUDE.md:444).
Preview crawlers (WhatsApp, Telegram, iMessage, X) set first_viewed_at and inflate /c/ hits, which skews every share-conversion metric.
Supabase calls are synchronous and run on the event loop while ENABLE_SYNC_DB_OFFLOAD is OFF. New share, OG and count routes block the loop and add latency to concurrent compares (p50 already 22 s).
Removing CohortBadge leaves the backend demographics read and the cohort prompt context running under ENABLE_COHORT_PERSONALIZATION. Its cost and tokens stay until that flag is reviewed.
Coming-soon refusals: there is no rule saying a refused skincare or makeup compare is not counted against the 3/day quota or refunded.
sources: J1 A5, R6 digests; J2 R12 digest
